description: This file defines the interface for an IPC client in the Rialto project, including classes for accessing the IPC client and creating IPC-related objects such as channels, closures, and controllers.

classes.name: IIpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Accessor class providing singleton access to the IIpcClient instance.

classes.name: IIpcClient
classes.description: Interface defining the IPC client API for communication with the Rialto server.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IIpcClientAccessor.

methods.name: getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IIpcClient object.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the IPC channel created by the client.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure for RPC stubs.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates an RPC controller for RPC stubs.
